tools.name: neverbounce_get_account_info
tools.description: Credits left (paid and free), credits used, and how many verification jobs are completed, queued, processing or under review. Free: it spends no credits. POST /account/info.

tools.name: neverbounce_verify_email
tools.description: WRITE: SPENDS 1 of your NeverBounce credits per call. Verifies ONE e-mail address and returns result (valid, invalid, disposable, catchall or unknown), flags (e.g. has_dns_mx, role_account, free_email_host), a suggested correction for typos like gmal.com, and optionally the parsed address parts. Nev

tools.name: neverbounce_list_jobs
tools.description: Bulk verification jobs of the account (most recent first as NeverBounce returns them) with id, status, filename, timestamps, totals per result (valid, invalid, catchall, disposable, unknown, duplicates, bad_syntax), bounce estimate and percent complete. Filter by id, exact filename or status. POST /

tools.name: neverbounce_get_job
tools.description: One verification job: status (waiting, parsing, running, complete, failed, under_review...), failure reason, timestamps, totals (records, billable = credits it will use, processed, valid, invalid, catchall, disposable, unknown, duplicates, bad_syntax), bounce estimate and percent complete. Poll this

tools.name: neverbounce_get_job_results
tools.description: Per-address results of a job: the submitted row (data) and its verification (result, flags, suggested_correction, address info). Paged; use neverbounce_download_job_results for a CSV. The job must be complete. POST /jobs/results.

tools.name: neverbounce_download_job_results
tools.description: The results of a complete job as CSV text (the submitted columns plus email_status), cut at 200000 characters with a note when longer (use neverbounce_get_job_results to page through large jobs). By default every result type is included; set a type to false to leave it out. POST /jobs/download.

tools.name: neverbounce_create_job
tools.description: WRITE: creates a bulk verification job from up to 100 e-mail addresses given in this call, and has NeverBounce parse it. It does NOT start the verification and spends NO credits; run neverbounce_start_job afterwards (that spends 1 credit per billable address). Put ALL the addresses of one list into

tools.name: neverbounce_start_job
tools.description: WRITE: STARTS a created job and SPENDS 1 credit per billable address (shown as total.billable in neverbounce_get_job); it cannot be stopped or undone. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: neverbounce_get_account_info, neverbounce_verify_email, neverbounce_list_jobs, neverbounce_get_job, neverbounce_get_job_results, neverbounce_create_job · Private data: neverbounce_verify_email, neverbounce_get_job · Public sink: neverbounce_get_account_info, neverbounce_verify_email, neverbounce_list_jobs, neverbounce_get_job, neverbounce_get_job_results, neverbounce_download_job_results, neverbounce_create_job, neverbounce_start_job · Destructive: neverbounce_create_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: neverbounce_get_account_info, neverbounce_verify_email, neverbounce_list_jobs, neverbounce_get_job, neverbounce_get_job_results, neverbounce_create_job · Private data: neverbounce_verify_email, neverbounce_get_job · Public sink: neverbounce_get_account_info, neverbounce_verify_email, neverbounce_list_jobs, neverbounce_get_job, neverbounce_get_job_results, neverbounce_download_job_results, neverbounce_create_job, neverbounce_start_job · Destructive: neverbounce_create_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
